pokedexEntries.bk: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

pokedexEntries.wh: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.
